nonblocking_issues.issue: Archived-formal comparison summarizes query/hit changes only; it does not summarize continuous selected box, Box IoU, or Mask IoU differences.
nonblocking_issues.evidence: An 8-row synthetic recount passed and reported zero query/hit changes despite changed reference box coordinates, IoU 1 to .875, and Mask IoU .5 to .375 for the same selected query.
nonblocking_issues.impact: Do not infer continuous-output equality from zero query/hit changes. Candidate coverage, matching and error partitions remain correct; no official score is overwritten.
nonblocking_issues.recommendation: Keep this limit explicit. If numerical comparison is later required, compute counts/max absolute differences from already-saved fields; no GPU rerun is needed.

checks.demonstrated_nonblocking_gap: Changed archived box/IoU/Mask values with unchanged query/hits are not counted by current comparison output.

limitations: Same-family provisional review, not cross-family acceptance.
Source and CPU mock checks only; no actual native Torch/GPU run was performed.
The fused terminal must finish formal evaluation before the existing sanity/full diagnostic sequence.
Scene-overlap and root-IoU qualification are offline geometric proxies, not physical/semantic identity proofs.
Saved historical ranking bins are top-K intervals, not exact first ranks.
